name: 22902 · Charlottesvle, VA
findings: ZIP 22902 (Charlottesvle) has 223 nonprofit organizations. 86 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (15% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 22902 (Charlottesvle) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
